position: An authorization decision is not an invitation, and a dry run must have no delivery side effect
headline: The request can be validated and hashed while identity, credentials, delivery, and participant access remain absent.
copy: Only a pseudonymous participant, private learner role, bounded source-first purpose, recorded consent, named founder owner, no delivery channel, and a maximum seventy-two-hour window are accepted.

postures.title: Dry-run evaluator
postures.copy: Safe and unsafe request shapes are deterministic.

postures.title: Current invitation
postures.copy: The repository holds no live invitation.

postures.title: Direct identity
postures.copy: Email, name, and phone fields are rejected.

postures.title: Delivery
postures.copy: No channel, token, account, or message is created.

flow.title: Authorize
flow.copy: Start from the bounded v5.0.6 decision.

flow.title: Describe
flow.copy: Use pseudonymous identity, purpose, consent, owner, and expiry.

flow.title: Digest
flow.copy: Create a deterministic founder-reviewable request hash.

decisions.label: Request contract
decisions.reason: The dry-run evaluator is covered by safe and unsafe fixtures.

decisions.label: Maximum scope
decisions.reason: Only one bounded invitation request is modeled.

decisions.label: Delivery attempts
decisions.reason: The contract has no delivery path.

decisions.label: Invitation issued
decisions.reason: Issuance remains a separate real-world decision.

locks.title: Identity lock
locks.copy: Only pseudonymous identifiers are accepted; direct identity is rejected.

locks.title: Invitation lock
locks.copy: No token, email, delivery, or live invitation is created.

locks.title: Participant lock
locks.copy: No participant account or real session exists.

locks.title: Provider lock
locks.copy: No external provider, notification, or durable participant write is touched.

locks.title: Public launch lock
locks.copy: Private validation cannot open public access.
